name: Peter F. Neronha
stance: Signed multistate letters opposing preemption and urging federal frontier-AI safety rules.

statements.text: Signed the 26-attorney-general letter urging Congress to immediately establish federal regulation and safety protocols for frontier AI (mandatory safety testing oversight, incident investigations, international coordination against harmful superintelligence) without preempting state law.
Joined the bipartisan 36-attorney-general NAAG letter urging Congress to reject a federal moratorium preempting state AI laws.
